title: Review Criteria Schema
description: Schema for .claude/metadata/review-criteria.json — type-specific review criteria for /review-issue

label.description: Display name for the issue type

criteria.description: Evaluation criteria for this issue type

overrides.description: Common criterion ID that this type-specific criterion supersedes

advisory.description: True for a criterion whose warning blocks nothing (#3587). When every non-pass criterion of a review is advisory and no acceptance-criterion verdict is warn or fail, review-finalize.js assigns the reviewed label and records Ready for work. Omitted means false.

conditionalAdvisory.description: True for a criterion whose warning is advisory only when the reviewer flags the finding advisory: true for the condition its autoCheck names (#3609; charter-alignment on charter-scope.js basis outweighed-out-of-scope). review-finalize.js honors the per-finding flag on a warn of such a criterion, for the reviewed type only, and ignores it on every other criterion and on a fail. Omitted means false.

env.description: Environment this criterion applies to (#2516). Omitted means 'both' — the default, correct for any criterion that is not framework-development-specific. 'dev' restricts it to a self-hosted framework repo; review-preamble.js filters such criteria out in user projects. Mirrors the env discriminator on framework-manifest.json deploymentFiles.rules.
